body.x: RF(mywindowmate.com), Korea's only window cleaning robot maker, finally received two CES Innovation Awards in its two years of business.

CES Innovation Awards is given by CES, one of the world's largest electronics trade show that began in 1976. The criteria for the award are technology, design, innovation, and customer value. Other Korean companies that received the award are Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, and SK Telecom.

RF have been developing the window cleaning robot for seven years, even before the company was founded, and it began selling it in Korea after it was proven to be marketable from the successful pilot sales in Japan.
The two products that received CES Innovation Awards are home model and customized model, in categories of "Home Appliances" and "Tech For A Better World", respectively.

WindowMate WM Series for home is the first successful window cleaning robot made with permanent magnet that does not fall off even when the electricity gets cut off. It is far safer than other attachment-type window cleaners. An upgraded model with reduced cost is expected to be launched within this year.

The custom-made window cleaning robot greatly reduces the risk of danger from cleaning the outside of the window manually with ropes, and this accounted highly in the judgment. It consists of three large cleaning panels, and it can also clean multiple floors in one run.

CEO Sharon Lee said, "It is significant that our product was the first product in the world to receive CES 2017 Innovation Award as a window cleaning robot. We will accelerate our process of sales and new product launch, and show our customers what a better customer value is with our robot."
WindowMate will be displayed in CES 2017, which will start Jan. 5.
